pool.text: A soldier carried off a monstrance containing the Blessed Sacrament during the city sack.
Emmanuel Philibert made Turin the capital of the Duchy of Savoy in this year.
The French besieged the city for 117 days without conquering it during the battle.
Turin became the capital of the newly proclaimed united Kingdom of Italy.
The capital was moved away from Turin to the city of Florence.
The first Italian cinema screening occurred in the city during the month of March.
The city served as one of the host locations for the FIFA World Cup.
The heaviest area bombing raid by the RAF took place on July 13.
RAI established a permanent television and radio production centre in the city.
The opening of the National Museum of Cinema took place in the city.
An important international flower and plant exhibition took place in the park during celebrations.
Film critic Gianni Rondolino created the festival that later became the Torino Film Festival.
The municipality hosted matches for the international FIFA World Cup tournament again.
Royal residences in the city and nearby towns were declared World Heritage Sites by UNESCO.
The economic strength of the city ranked third in Italy after Milan and Rome.
The municipality successfully hosted the Winter Olympic Games.
The city generated a large gross domestic product and ranked high globally in purchasing power.
The Globalization and World Cities Research Network ranked the municipality as a specific global city.
Stefano Lo Russo was elected as the current mayor of the city.
The European music competition was hosted in the city following a national victory.
